Dear Lamia,

How are you? I hope you are well. I am also well by the Grace of Almighty Allah. Now. I am going to describe the future plan after passing HSC Exam.

Our HSC Exam is coming soon. I am prepared so well for the HSC Exam. I have future plan after passing the HSC Exam. I take preparation for HSC Exam beside of this I am also taking preparation for Admission test. After the HSC Exam, I will go to my village. In my village, there are many illiterate people. They don't know how to live, a happy and healthy life. I want to educate them. for live a healthy and planned life, education is must. Education helps them to do their work very easily. Many farmers of my village are not educated. Because of this they don't know how to farming very well. Their childs also don't get education. Because of this they also do many works to live a happy life. If they educated well, they will do work. I want to see the shine of my village. So, I will go there and help people to get education. My village is so much beautiful. If you don't have any plan after the HSC Exam, you can join with me. You will also help me to educate the people of my village. I will be very happy if you join with me.

No more today. Give my salam to yours parents and love to youngers.
Yours ever
Sadia
